remarks: A truly exceptional opportunity to own 20 acres of prime riverfront land within the City of Edmonton. Ideally positioned for future growth, this rare parcel offers an incredible blend of natural beauty, strategic location, and long-term potential. The property enjoys extensive frontage and stunning views along the river, creating a spectacular setting unlike anything else on the market. Whether you're an investor, developer, or visionary landowner, opportunities of this scale and location are increasingly hard to find. Surrounded by Edmonton's expanding boundaries, the combination of city proximity, riverfront exposure, and substantial acreage creates endless possibilities while offering the privacy and tranquility of a natural setting. Invest in Edmonton's future while enjoying the beauty of riverfront ownership today. (id:67522)
